name: Signal
flavor: Holds trains out of an occupied block. Place on track.

name: Water Tower
flavor: Nearby stations load faster and fill water tanks completely.

name: Coaling Stage
flavor: Nearby stations fill fuel tanks completely instead of a half top-up.

name: Power Line
flavor: Carries power along the rails. Chain poles within reach of each other and of a Power Plant.

name: Townhouse
flavor: Homes for ten to begin with. People move in while there is wheat, a full house grows a storey, and a crowded town builds more on its own. With a warehouse near a town station it founds a town; more people mean more passengers and more mouths to feed.
